question: Which of the following five year plan of India was a complete failure?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Third Five Year Plan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Third Five Year Plan** was implemented from 1961 to 1966.
 
• This plan aimed at making India self-reliant and self-generating in agricultural and industrial production.
 
• However, the plan was a **complete failure** due to several factors.
 
• It coincided with the Indo-China War (1962) and the Indo-Pakistan War (1965), which diverted resources and focus.
 
• Severe droughts in 1965 and 1966 further crippled the agricultural sector.
 
• As a result, the economy faced severe setbacks, and the plan did not meet its targets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **First Five Year Plan** (1951-1956) focused on agriculture and irrigation.
 
• The **Second Five Year Plan** (1956-1961) emphasized industrialization.
 
• The **Fourth Five Year Plan** (1969-1974) aimed at growth with stability and progressive achievement of self-reliance.
 
• The **Fifth Five Year Plan** (1974-1978) focused on removing poverty and achieving self-reliance.
 
• The **Seventh Five Year Plan** (1985-1990) aimed at accelerating food grain production, increasing employment, and raising productivity.
